```{r setup, include=FALSE}
require(knitr)
require(tidyverse)
require(plotly)
require(shiny)
require(shinydashboard)
#require(htmltools)

#set root directory to where app ius to be able to source files
functionsDirectory <- file.path(params$appRoot, "functions")
# #functions
neededFunctions <- c("getCombinedSummariesTables.R", "getLengthWeightGraph.R")
# 
for (i in neededFunctions) {
  source(file.path(functionsDirectory, i))
}
sampleFData <- params$sampleFData()

title_style <- "background-color: #e2f0d9; 
                padding: 10px 20px; 
                border-radius: 15px; 
                font-weight: bold; 
                margin-bottom: 10px; 
                width: 100%;"
```

`r if(params$combinedSummaries$display) "## Combined Summaries"`

```{r combinedSummaries, include=TRUE, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE,message=FALSE,error=FALSE}
if(params$combinedSummaries$display){
  
  combinedSummariesTables <- getCombinedSummariesTables(groupByCols = params$combinedSummaries$groupingCols, data = sampleFData)
  
  tagList(
    tags$div("Mean, Min, Max Length/Weight", style = title_style),
    combinedSummariesTables$meanMinMaxLengthWeightsTable,
    tags$br(), 
    
    tags$div("Proportional Stocking Density and Catch/Unit Effort", style = title_style),
    combinedSummariesTables$proportionalstockdensityTable,
    tags$br(), 
    
    tags$div("Relative Abundance and Catch/Unit Effort", style = title_style),
    combinedSummariesTables$relAbundanceCPUETable
  )
  
  
}

```

`r if(params$lengthFrequencyGraph$display) "## Length Frequencies"`

```{r lfGraph, include=TRUE, echo=FALSE}
if(params$lengthFrequencyGraph$display){

  # plot <- sampleFData %>%
  #   ggplot(aes(x = .data[[params$lengthFrequencyGraph$lengthOptions]], 
  #              fill = CommonName)) +
  #   theme_classic() +
  #   labs(title = "Length Frequencies", caption = paste("Binwidth = 20mm"))
  
  if(params$lengthFrequencyGraph$lengthOptions == "RSD"){
    sampleFDataRSD <- sampleFData %>%
      #this works as long as there are no group RSD designations if there are a like 20 fish in the "numfish" column
      count(RSD, CommonName, name = "Count") %>%
      left_join(params$rsdLimits, by = "CommonName") %>%
      mutate(hoverText = case_when(RSD == "Stock" ~ paste0(CommonName, " 'Stock' Range (mm): ", SLEN, " - ", QLEN), 
                                   RSD == "Quality" ~ paste0(CommonName, " 'Quality' Range (mm): ", QLEN, " - ", PLEN), 
                                   RSD == "Preferred" ~ paste0(CommonName, " 'Preferred' Range (mm): ", PLEN, " - ", MLEN), 
                                   RSD == "Memorable" ~ paste0(CommonName, " 'Memorable' Range (mm): ", MLEN, " - ", TLEN), 
                                   RSD == "Trophy" ~ paste0(CommonName, " 'Trophy' Range (mm): ", TLEN, "+"), 
                                   TRUE ~ paste0(CommonName, ": No RSD Assigned")
                                   
      ), 
      RSD = factor(RSD, levels = c("Stock", "Quality", "Preferred", "Memorable", "Trophy"))) %>%
      ungroup()
    plot <- ggplot(sampleFDataRSD, aes(x = RSD, y = Count, fill = CommonName, text = hoverText)) +
      geom_col() +
      labs(caption = "RSD (mm)")
    
  } else{
    plot <- sampleFData %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = .data[[params$lengthFrequencyGraph$lengthOptions]], 
                 fill = CommonName)) +
      #theme_classic() +
      # labs(title = "Length Frequencies", caption = "Binwidth = 20mm") +
      geom_histogram(binwidth = params$lengthFrequencyGraph$binwidth, 
                     aes(
                       group = CommonName,
                       label = CommonName,
                       text = paste0("Length ", if_else(params$lengthFrequencyGraph$lengthOptions == "Length_mm", "(mm)", "(inches)"), ' Range: ', after_stat(xmin), " to ", after_stat(xmax),  
                                     "<br>Count: ", after_stat(count),
                                     '<br>Species: ', after_stat(label)
                       )
                     )) +
      labs(caption = paste(params$lengthFrequencyGraph$lengthOptions, ": Binwidth", params$lengthFrequencyGraph$binwidth))
  }
  plot <- plot + 
    theme_classic() +
    labs(title = "Length Frequencies") #, caption = "Binwidth = 20mm"

  #+
  #scale_fill_manual(values = allColors)
  ggplotly(plot, tooltip = "text")
  
} 
```
